Name: Fancy cats
Author: Chimneyswallow
Description:
This mod is purely cosmetic and adds longer tails to cats. Also there are a few new colours to choose.
If you have any suggestions, please contact me.

How to install:
unzip folder and paste cat.xnb in Stardew Valley > Content > Animals
Replace the default one, but don`t forget, to make a copy!

It only replaces the default cat, if you chose one of the other cat options (new in 1.4), you have to rename it according to the cat you chose.

Downloads.Description: Cats with longer tails and some new colours
